CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 nice -n 15 /home/ms-admin/workspace1/.miniforge3/envs/hbf-cxl/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json
base = Path.cwd() / "models/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ"
train_files = sorted((base / "calibration/real").glob("repeat-*/cases/*/TP0.raw_request.jsonl"))
held = base / "holdout/real/repeat-1/cases/latency_256x128_r1"
bundle = base / "calibration/training/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ_hgbmono_p50.pkl"
assert len(train_files) == 15
files = train_files + [held / name for name in ("TP0.raw_request.jsonl", "autobench_trace.jsonl", "TP0.manifest.json", "status.txt")] + [bundle]
before = {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in files}
def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
train = [item for path in train_files for item in rows(path)]
test = rows(held / "TP0.raw_request.jsonl")
traces = rows(held / "autobench_trace.jsonl")
train_ids = {item["rid"] for item in train}
test_ids = {item["rid"] for item in test}
train_prompts = {tuple(item["input_ids"]) for item in train}
test_prompts = {tuple(item["input_ids"]) for item in test}
assert (len(train), len(train_ids), len(train_prompts)) == (800, 800, 480)
assert len(test) == len(test_ids) == len(test_prompts) == 32
assert not train_ids & test_ids
assert not train_prompts & test_prompts
manifest = json.loads((held / "TP0.manifest.json").read_text())
assert (held / "status.txt").read_text().strip() == "ok"
assert manifest["request_count"] == 32
assert len(traces) == 32
copies = {item["metadata"]["source_rid"]: item for item in traces}
assert set(copies) == test_ids
for item in test:
    copied = copies[item["rid"]]
    assert item["input_ids"] == copied["prompt"]
    assert len(item["input_ids"]) == item["input_length"] == copied["prompt_len"]
    assert len(item["output_ids"]) == item["output_length"] == copied["output_len"]
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected for path, expected in before.items())
print(json.dumps({"observed_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "scope": "All AWQ training requests versus the first completed held-out case only; no fit/predict/GPU/profile, not all held-out data or accuracy.", "training_requests": len(train), "distinct_training_prompts": len(train_prompts), "first_held_case_requests": len(test), "distinct_first_held_case_prompts": len(test_prompts), "shared_rids": len(train_ids & test_ids), "shared_complete_input_prompts": len(train_prompts & test_prompts), "native_to_trace_payloads_checked": len(test), "source_files_verified_unchanged": len(before), "p50_bundle_sha256": before[str(bundle)], "source_sha256": before}, ensure_ascii=False))
